tests.command: from research worktree ns3b_beliefmatching directory: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest -q test_beliefmatching_adapter

failure_injection.construction_failure: Injected before adapter creation; bank names and baseline identity remained unchanged.
failure_injection.binding_failure: Injected after actual adapter construction; adapter was closed and disabled; bank remained unchanged.
failure_injection.registration_failure: Injected before bank mutation; adapter was closed and disabled; bank remained unchanged.
failure_injection.actual_duplicate_registration_rejection: Existing same-name registration remained intact; newly constructed adapter was closed and disabled; bank and registry continued to reference only the original decoder.

limitations: Registration failure injection covers pre-mutation failure and the real duplicate-name rejection path; it does not simulate process-level memory exhaustion during Python dictionary insertion.
The imported-file SHA-256 is not a digest of the complete upstream repository. The dependency lock pins the repository commit; the individual digest checks the copied adapter file.
